audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gives Camille 6 of 7 stages while Dr. Mundo wins 55.08% over 1122 games; full-layer phases and content win[] also disagree with each other (phases[4-6]=Skill vs win[4-6]=Skill/whys[6]=Dr. Mundo).
audit.why: Difficulty is real early (true-damage Q, Hookshot knockup) but the sustain war flips once Mundo stacks HP; the chart must land on Dr. Mundo late to match the win rate.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-5 Camille, Level 6 Skill, First item and 2+ items Dr. Mundo, with whys aligned to each side field.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item and late spikes were written as still Camille-favoured, contradicting the two-item flip described in the same text.
audit.why: Heartsteel/Warmog's HP stacking caps Camille's percent-health Tactical Sweep and Maximum Dosage regen outlasts a 90s ultimate cooldown at rank 3.
audit.corrected: Spike ownership: Camille lvl 3-5 and lvl 6; Dr. Mundo from first item onward.
sources: ownerKit R cd 120 / enemyKit R cd 140/115/90

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated that Dr. Mundo's passive resists the first immobilizing effect, i.e. Hookshot's knockup, nor that The Hextech Ultimatum is a dash plus an anchoring zone rather than a stun/channel.
audit.why: Riot's text for Mundo's passive: he resists the first Immobilizing effect and drops a canister. Riot's text for Camille R describes a dash and anchoring — the kit file's channel/untargetable flags are tooltip-parse misfires, matching the mirror audit's note.
audit.corrected: Passive eats the Hookshot knockup once (canister pickup heals and lowers its cooldown), and Hookshot is a 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown; Camille's ult anchors rather than stuns, so Maximum Dosage can be pressed on arrival.

audit.why: Hookshot cooldown is the defining window; brief already keys commits to it.

edits.before: R (The Hextech Ultimatum) isolates you and out-DPSes your heal at 6 — Camille.
edits.after: R (The Hextech Ultimatum) isolates you, but Maximum Dosage answers it — Skill.

edits.before: First item's Q burst and E reset still beat your one component — Camille.
edits.after: First HP item outgrows her Q burst window and her W cap — Dr. Mundo.

edits.before: Her true-damage Q melts your HP — bait her E and build resists, not raw HP. Dr. Mundo wins by out-sustaining Camille's windows around Hookshot and cashing the pattern: bait E, build resists, and out-scale her shred.
edits.after: Precision Protocol's delayed second hit is true damage, so resists blunt her autos, not that. Your passive resists the first immobilizing effect — it eats her Hookshot knockup and drops a canister you walk up to heal. Fight after that.

edits.before: Camille owns the lane early: Q (Precision Protocol) true-damage second hit and W (Tactical Sweep) outer-cone heal let her out-trade your slow body while her E (Hookshot) stun locks you for the combo.
edits.after: Camille owns the lane early: Precision Protocol's delayed second hit is true damage and the outer half of Tactical Sweep heals her; your passive eats one Hookshot knockup, then it is a 16s wait at rank 1.

edits.before: Camille R (The Hextech Ultimatum) traps you for a full Q-W rotation — with her true damage and % health W she out-DPSes your R heal in the isolated fight.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) is a dash onto you plus an anchoring zone, not a stun — press Maximum Dosage as she lands, walk to the zone edge, and her 140s rank-1 ult bought her nothing.

notes: Camille kit flags 'channel'/'untargetable' on R contradict Riot's own description (dash + anchoring zone); treated as tooltip-parse misfires, matching the mirror audit. tradeGood/breakdown.trading and report[3].t contain scraped PDF junk ('• • Dr. Mundo Top Lane Matchup Database 103') — champion-wide corruption, left alone here to avoid length-band failures; flag for a cleanup pass.
